description: This Java class defines AnimateDrawable, a custom drawable that supports animation through an Android Animation object. It extends ProxyDrawable and allows applying transformations during drawing, based on the animation's state.

classes.name: AnimateDrawable
classes.description: A drawable that supports animation by applying transformations based on an Animation object.

methods.name: AnimateDrawable
methods.description: Constructor that wraps a Drawable and associates an Animation.

methods.name: setAnimation
methods.description: Sets the Animation object used for this drawable.

methods.name: hasStarted
methods.description: Checks if the animation has started.

methods.name: hasEnded
methods.description: Checks if the animation has ended.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Draws the wrapped drawable applying current animation transformation if applicable.
